t: This is the Tinworth pillar, a column in Kennington Park. It's the only part that remains of the Tinworth Fountain. It was made by George Tinworth, an English ceramic artist who worked for the Doulton factory at Lambeth from 1867 until his death. So this surviving pillar is a trace of a Lambeth craftsman whose career was spent at Doulton, not far from where you're standing.
